physical_risk_assessment.road_runoff: Unbraked contrast may reach the east map edge; requested cruise is bounded to 5 m/s but original trajectory must be checked.
physical_risk_assessment.camera_visibility: Four requested views may not show qualifying lamp color and motion throughout the approach; original pixels require review.
physical_risk_assessment.subject_qualification: A CARLA police blueprint and Special1 request do not establish statutory vehicle authorization or lamp compliance.
physical_risk_assessment.response_proxy: Brake actuation and stopping distance are engineering observations, not a legal threshold for prepared to stop.
physical_risk_assessment.source_indication: A proxy arm pose is not proof that the source driver or an officer gave a visible, applicable signal; original actor, identity, pixels and timing need review.
